heading: Upward Flag Football & Cheer
intro: Saturday mornings under the fall sky, with every player in the action and every cheerleader part of the full game-day experience.
photoAlt: Three Upward flag football players flexing with their backs to the camera, showing jerseys 13, 25, and 23

who.title: Flag football: kindergarten through high school
who.text: Boys and girls who turn 5 by July 31, 2027. Divisions are co-ed.

who.title: Cheer: kindergarten through 8th grade
who.text: Girls who turn 5 by July 31, 2027. Teams are organized by grade, and some teams may combine grades depending on registration.

who.title: Register by fall grade
who.text: Sign up in the grade your child is **going into** in fall 2027. All skill levels are welcome.

schedule.title: Flag football practice
schedule.text: One 60-minute evening practice a week on Monday, Tuesday, or Thursday.

schedule.title: Kindergarten and 1st grade flag
schedule.text: No weeknight practice. Instead, a mini practice right before each Saturday game.

schedule.title: Cheer practice
schedule.text: One 60-minute practice a week. Monday nights for 2nd through 8th grade, Thursday nights for kindergarten and 1st grade.

schedule.title: Games
schedule.text: One game every Saturday, morning or early afternoon depending on division.

registrationNotes: Registration is complete once full payment is received. Spots are limited and divisions may fill before the deadline.

kits.title: Flag football kit
kits.bring: Mouth guard (required for all ages) and football cleats (optional for kindergarten and 1st grade).

dates.label: Registration deadline
dates.note: Late fee applies after this date.

dates.label: Team placements sent
dates.note: Team, coach, practice night, and season schedule arrive by text and email.

dates.label: First practices: flag football, 2nd to 12th grade
dates.note: Weather permitting. Watch for your team’s night and time.

dates.label: First practice: flag football, kindergarten and 1st
Outdoor games
dates.note: Saturdays. No games on Labor Day weekend.

datesNote: There are no makeup games during the season.
